data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 3,345.9m. During 2020 there was an overall small gross release on prior year claims of GBP 11.5m (a c.0.34% release of opening reserves), per the insurance liabilities movement note. The movement reflected mixed developments across divisions: prior year net reserve releases in 2019 (notably a GBP 45.0m net release in the Reinsurance division driven by non-cat favourable development and releases on 2018 & prior large losses) were partly offset by a net strengthening in 2020 driven by increased estimates on 2019 large losses. COVID-19 and a number of natural catastrophe events in 2020 (including Hurricanes Laura and Sally, Midwest Derecho, Oregon and California wildfires, Tennessee tornados) materially influenced current year claims and reserve uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: the Syndicate's claims ratio deteriorated to 76% (2019: 64%), primarily reflecting the impact of the COVID pandemic, but also the impact of a large number of natural catastrophe events.

In terms of COVID losses, the Syndicate has recorded a gross best estimate loss of GBP 229.0 million. After reinsurance recoveries of GBP 93.0 million, the net best estimate loss of GBP 136.0 million, representing 11% of the loss ratio.
These events have exceeded our loss expectations for this type of event and contributed 7% to the loss ratio.

Additionally, the RI division benefitted from GBP 45.0 million of net reserve releases in 2019 (driven by non-Cat loss ratio improvements in Cat NA and Risk XL, plus releases on other 2018 & prior accident year large losses), whilst in 2020 there was a net strengthening of GBP 20.0 million, mainly due to increased estimates on 2019 large losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior year movement extracted from the Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding) and note 11(a) 'Net outstanding claims' movement table respectively (gross insurance liabilities column). The report also quotes divisional net movements (e.g. RI division net release GBP 45.0m in 2019 and net strengthening GBP 20.0m in 2020) which are net of reinsurance; those net figures are quoted verbatim in the narrative but were NOT used for the required gross prior-year movement. Per-line gross prior-year movements are not provided; some lob-level amounts in lob_movements are therefore inferred or left null. A gross claims development triangle is available in the notes and has been included in _claims_triangle.
